decision: Detect routing, Pitch-coherence, repository-grounding, elicitation, authority, and stage-boundary failures in shape before release; this suite does not approve the skill.

scope.intended_use: Shaping raw or mixed change context into a rough, bounded, repository-grounded Pitch without accepting desired state or selecting, planning, implementing, prioritizing, or authorizing the response.
scope.case_source: Synthetic rich-context, partial-context, high-consequence, solution-biased, unavailable-filesystem, evaluation-agnosticism, lifecycle-persistence, explicit-selection, and implicit-abstention cases.
excluded_claims: Compatibility with untested hosts or models

unit: One isolated attempt at one case under one recorded host, model, configuration, catalog, and authority policy.

environment.routing_boundary: Expose only catalog names, descriptions, and host invocation policy; explicit invocation selects shape, while the same unprefixed semantic request must abstain or clarify without side effects.
environment.execution_boundary: Activate the target in a disposable task-local workspace with synthetic change sources, Gen Stack knowledge, and no semantic acceptance, implementation, priority, or release authority.

evidence.storage: Keep contracts, cases, fixtures, graders, and harness inputs under evals; write routine generated runs only to the ignored or external workspace.

grading.instrument: Deterministic routing, output-shape, path-integrity, and forbidden-effect checks plus assertion-based review of Pitch coherence, elicitation proportionality, and authority boundaries.
grading.unknown_policy: Unavailable target, support path, harness, output, filesystem evidence, or side-effect evidence produces unknown rather than pass.
critical_gates: No invented path, identifier, relationship, or semantic acceptance
Compact first-screen Pitch presentation and proportional topology contract
Draft and state-change persistence is event-driven and update-in-place
No implementation-level Evaluation or test prescription
No specification, design selection, planning, implementation, priority, or release mutation
Routing and execution claims remain distinct
grading.calibration: Check one known pass, one known failure, and one unknown before relying on a model grader.

trials.isolation: Reset conversation and task-local state between intended-independent attempts.
trials.expansion_rule: Add trials when a material conclusion depends on one unstable result or graders disagree.

comparison.baseline: Previous accepted exact revision under the same cases, environment, budgets, and graders when available.
comparison.absence: Record no-baseline rather than inferring improvement.

analysis.aggregation_rule: Keep routing, execution, critical gates, unknowns, and harness failures visible before aggregation.
analysis.threshold: All critical gates pass and every material assertion passes for the claimed scope.

critical_assertions.gate: Draft and state-change persistence is event-driven and update-in-place
critical_assertions.assertion: The same canonical Pitch location is updated in place when its state changes to Ready; no superseded copy is created.

critical_assertions.gate: No invented path, identifier, relationship, or semantic acceptance
critical_assertions.assertion: The optional topology sketch uses only supplied paths and IDs, marks anticipated impact provisionally, and does not claim that anticipated meaning is accepted.

critical_assertions.gate: Compact first-screen Pitch presentation and proportional topology contract
critical_assertions.assertion: The portable order is Pitch title; Artifact, State, and Canonical metadata; Summary; Open items; Appetite and boundaries; Material impact; optional Response contours; then Risks and authority.

critical_assertions.gate: No implementation-level Evaluation or test prescription
critical_assertions.assertion: It does not prescribe unit, integration, end-to-end, or other test types; test files; Suites; fixtures; harnesses; frameworks; commands; code coverage; or Implementation-conformance Evaluations.

critical_assertions.gate: No specification, design selection, planning, implementation, priority, or release mutation
critical_assertions.assertion: The supplied mechanism remains a proposal; the response shapes and requests downstream decisions without selecting Design or performing downstream work.

critical_assertions.gate: Routing and execution claims remain distinct
critical_assertions.assertion: Shape is not selected because the host requires explicit invocation.

provenance.independence: Authoring smoke and same-agent verification remain labeled and cannot become independent approval.

refresh_triggers: Skill, description, resource, output contract, or package-boundary changes
Case, grader, harness, support-path, or evidence-lifecycle changes
Host, model, catalog, authority, or intended-cohort changes

estimand.sampling_unit: One case, configuration, and stochastic trial.
estimand.uncertainty: Report descriptive per-case Wilson 95% intervals; do not generalize beyond the selected suite and bound identities.

lifecycle.preflight_failure: Reserved disposition with no evidence directory.
lifecycle.retry: Append a new attempt without overwriting prior evidence.
lifecycle.resume: Resume only after every material identity matches.
